title: Practice 1.5
role: Account manager checking what a client said and confirming it by paraphrase
can_do: I can report what someone said with the right verbs and tenses.
I can confirm my understanding by paraphrasing.

items.prompt: Which sentence reports I will send the file tomorrow?

options.text: She said that she would send the file the next day.
She said that she will send the file tomorrow.
She said that she sent the file the next day.

items.explanation: In reported speech will becomes would and tomorrow becomes the next day.

o2.text: After said, will changes to would.

o3.text: Will send does not become sent.

items.template: He asked me {1} I had signed the form.

error_tag.text: A yes/no question is reported with whether or if.

items.explanation: A reported yes/no question uses whether or if.

items.template: If I understand you {1}, the price includes the transfer.

error_tag.text: The usual phrase is if I understand you correctly.

items.explanation: If I understand you correctly is a polite way to confirm.
In other words introduces a paraphrase of what was said.

error_tag.text: Start with the linking phrase In other words.

items.prompt: Match the reporting verb with its use.

right.text: to draw attention to a fact

items.explanation: Reporting verbs show what kind of speech act it was.

items.prompt: Paraphrase to confirm: you mean the meeting is on Monday.
accepted: So you mean the meeting is on Monday
If I understand you correctly you mean the meeting is on Monday
If I understand you correctly the meeting is on Monday
So the meeting is on Monday
items.explanation: Use So you mean ... or If I understand you correctly ...
